summary: Mill Facing bug fixes that also change user-visible behaviour: PassExtension is hidden for the Spiral clearing pattern in both the property view and task panel, StepOver now clamps to 1–100 and the task-panel spinbox shows whole percent, negative StockExtension is limited so the stock rectangle cannot collapse, the engagement offset is dropped so passes extend only by PassExtension plus tool radius, a single pass is centred on the stock, and an empty toolpath now warns instead of raising.

pages.reason: Path/Op/MillFacing.py: opUpdateEditorModes hides PassExtension when ClearingPattern is Spiral and StepOver minimum clamps to 1 (was 0); Op/Gui/MillFacing.py updateVisibility hides the PassExtension task-panel field for Spiral; PageOpMillFacingEdit.ui StepOver decimals 1→0; opExecute limits negative StockExtension to half the shortest boundary edge and warns on an empty toolpath; facing_common.generate_t_values centres a single pass and drops calculate_engagement_offset so pass length is PassExtension + tool radius
Path/Geom.py only gains isStrictlyLess/isLessEqual/isGreaterEqual helpers and the facing generators are Mill Facing internals; nothing on the Area page is affected
